hero.subtitle: App for managing vehicle rentals
hero.imageAlt: Mowcar: app for managing vehicle rentals

about.title: A case study on simplifying complex operations without losing control.
about.p1: Mowcar is a personal project that started with a question: can a car rental business be managed with a lean app, without giving up the critical flows?
about.p2: I worked as the solo designer, from mapping requirements to a clickable prototype in Figma. The focus was to prioritize what really matters to the operator every day.

challenge.title: Context and challenge
challenge.p1: The vehicle rental market has many operational steps: registration, fleet control, pickup, return, history and tracking. Most existing solutions handle all of it with too much complexity.
challenge.p2: The challenge was to prioritize: which flows are critical for a working MVP, and which can wait?
items: Two distinct user profiles: renter and fleet manager
A critical flow with many steps: booking, pickup, use and return
Need for real-time visibility into the status of each vehicle

process.title: The project followed a practical, product-oriented approach:
items: MVP scope definition and information architecture mapping
Navigation flows, wireframes and prototyping in Figma
Design system with reusable components and visual tokens

solution.title: The final solution was a mobile app focused on:
items: Visual hierarchy that highlights the current status of each vehicle
Built-in map to give context to location and active routes
Critical actions (pick up, open, return) reduced to the fewest steps
Consistent visual pattern with reusable components across the app
solution.note: The design was made for use on the move: the operator needs to act fast, without digging through complex menus to finish a simple task.
